tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Brand yellow. A fill, never a text colour: header bands, the primary button, selected options and chips. Text on it is ink (10.3:1). Only 1.6:1 against paper, so never use it for text, thin lines or icons on paper or surface.

tokens.name: yellow-soft
tokens.usage: Light yellow for hover and highlighted rows, such as an option you hover over or a note that needs a little attention. Text on it is ink (14.7:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Near-black. All main text, headings, the wordmark, the ruler, the primary button border and the focus ring. 16.5:1 on paper, 17.3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on paper and surface: hints under labels, helper lines, footer notes. 6.6:1 on paper, 6.9:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted-on-yellow
tokens.usage: Secondary text on yellow, such as the subtitle in a yellow header band. 5.9:1 on yellow.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Warm off-white, the same as the printed cards.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Form panels, input fields and anything that sits on paper and needs to read as a separate object.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and the outline of a form panel. Too light for controls (1.3:1): use field-border for anything people click or type in.

tokens.name: field-border
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, checkboxes and unselected chips. 3.7:1 on surface, 3.5:1 on paper, so controls stay visible.

tokens.name: placeholder
tokens.usage: Placeholder text inside empty fields. 5.4:1 on surface. Keep placeholders as examples, not instructions: put instructions in the label or hint.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text, the border of a field with a problem, and error icons. 6.6:1 on surface, 5.8:1 on error-soft. Always pair it with a written message.

tokens.name: error-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an error summary at the top of a form. Text on it is ink or error.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons, such as the heading of the enquiry-sent message. 5.3:1 on surface, 4.7:1 on success-soft.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of the enquiry-sent panel. Text on it is ink or success.

tokens.name: wine
tokens.usage: Event colour from the guestbook board's lettering and the wedding signs. For wedding-facing pages and print only, never in the same component as yellow. 12.7:1 on paper, 11.1:1 on blush.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Soft pink ground that goes with wine on wedding signs and themed screens. Text on it is wine or ink.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Lowercase page headlines, like the pricing cards. One per page. Drop to 48px on phones.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Lowercase section headings inside a page or form.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Video guestbook hire in Auckland and Hamilton
styles.usage: The line under a display headline.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We bring one guestbook to one event per date, so send us yours and we'll check it's free.
styles.usage: Paragraphs and the text people type into fields.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, above the field. Sentence case.

styles.name: hint
styles.sample: We'll only use this to reply to you.
styles.usage: Help text under a label, error messages and footer notes. Colour ink-muted, or error for errors.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button text. Say what happens: Send enquiry, Check my date.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its field, and between chips.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between fields in a group; phone side margins.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Form panel padding on phones; gap between field groups.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Form panel padding on larger screens; space above the footer ruler.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small tags and the tick boxes in package tables.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, form panels and colour bands, the same as the printed cards.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, such as the event type choices (wedding, birthday, baby shower).

shadow.note: The brand is flat: no drop shadows. The only shadow is the focus ring.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on any control: a 2px ink ring with a yellow halo. The ink ring carries the contrast; the yellow is the brand touch.
